citations.title: Delaware Division of Revenue, Tax Tips for Lessors of Tangible Personal Property Conducting Business in Delaware (2018)
citations.quote: Leases of tangible personal property are subject to a use/lease tax at the rate of 1.9914% which is imposed on the lessee and collected and remitted by the lessor.

notes: Date is the checked archive capture of the same no-sales-tax statement. Seller gross receipts tax is outside this general sales-tax model. Delaware’s separate 1.9914% use/lease tax under Title 30 chapter 43 is not modeled, as directed by the brief; the exemption here means no GENERAL sales tax, not no tax on the lease. The lessors publication lists exceptions including household furniture, fixtures and furnishings.
